triples.tail_surface: RECHECK ALIGNMENT AFTER THE PUMP UNIT IS INSTALLED
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 泵机组安装后重新检查对中
triples.evidence_text: BE SURE TO RECHECK ALIGNMENT AFTER THE PUMP UNIT IS INSTALLED!

triples.tail_surface: straightedge ... across the coupling must rest evenly on both rims at the top, bottom, and sides
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 直尺在联轴器两端轮缘上下左右均匀贴合
triples.evidence_text: At a minimum, a straightedge (such as a piece of key stock) across the coupling must rest evenly on both rims at the top, bottom, and sides.

triples.tail_surface: using a long straightedge or tightly drawn string across the face of the sheaves
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 使用长直尺或拉紧细绳横跨带轮端面检查
triples.evidence_text: If the pump is driven by V-belts, check the alignment by using a long straightedge or tightly drawn string across the face of the sheaves.

triples.tail_surface: Check pump ports to be sure they are square and in the proper position
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查泵口是否方正且位置正确
triples.evidence_text: Check pump ports to be sure they are square and in the proper position; shim or move the pump as required.

triples.tail_surface: Make a final check on alignment after piping is hooked up
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 管路连接后最终检查对中
triples.evidence_text: Make a final check on alignment after piping is hooked up.

triples.tail_surface: allow the pump to reach operating temperature, then recheck alignment
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 待泵达到工作温度后重新检查对中
triples.evidence_text: For high temperature applications (those above 300°F) allow the pump to reach operating temperature, then recheck alignment.

triples.tail_surface: shim or move the pump as required
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 按需加垫片或移动泵体
triples.evidence_text: Check pump ports to be sure they are square and in the proper position; shim or move the pump as required.

triples.tail_surface: personal injury and/or damage to the unit
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 人身伤害和/或设备损坏
triples.evidence_text: Improper lifts can result in personal injury and/or damage to the unit.

triples.tail_surface: NEVER lift the unit with slings connected to the component lifting features
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 严禁使用连接到部件起吊点的吊索起吊机组
triples.evidence_text: NOTE: NEVER lift the unit with slings connected to the component lifting features.
